newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine debt $99.7 bln at end of second quarter.
newsitem.headline: Argentine debt $99.7 bln at end of second quarter.

text.p: Argentina's total outstanding public sector debt rose to $99.7 billion at the end of the second quarter, up from $98.3 billion a quarter earlier, the Economy Ministry said.
Of this total, $72.8 billion was denominated in debt issues. Foreign currency issues accounted for $64.4 billion and $8.4 billion was in peso-denominated bonds, the Economy Ministry said.
The remaining debt was distributed between bilateral and multilateral lenders and private banks. Argentina had $8.6 billion of bilateral debt, $5.3 billion of which was Paris Club debt.

Multilateral debt amounted to $16.6 billion. Loans from the International Monetary Fund came to $6.2 billion and debt with the Inter-American Development Bank stood at $5.0 billion at the end of the second quarter.
Debt with private banks was $1.6 billion.
